# External link audit

Checked 20 October 2026. All 65 unique external learning/setup destinations in the Markdown and resource catalog were requested. Sixty-two returned HTTP 200, with titles matching their intended destinations. Three O’Reilly pages returned HTTP 403 to the local automated client; the same exact publisher URLs were then opened through browser-based web retrieval and their book titles confirmed. They remain valid links, with automated access restricted.

This checks destination availability and identity. It does not claim video playback, purchase access, course completion, or execution of third-party exercises. Local file/section links and downloads are checked separately by the content validator and exhaustive browser audit. The private GitHub clone was verified using authorized Git credentials; localhost links require the documented server to be running.
